postprocess.note: Generated on magenta chroma background. After alpha extraction, the canonical source PNG was recomposited onto exact opaque #ff00ff so repo source corners are stable.

design_notes.subject: Milkring, a bipedal Holstein dairy-cow Lingpet with a milk-blast skill identity.
design_notes.goggles: Large dark smoked-cyan battle goggles cover both eyes completely.
design_notes.equipment: Minimal futuristic equipment only: ring collar, one small milk tank, wrist nozzle gauntlets.
design_notes.udder: Small wholesome mascot-style cow udder, not eroticized.
design_notes.avoid: No full armor suit, bulky shoulder pads, many tanks, many tubes, huge cannons, or visible eyes.
